title: SG-6.4.1 · Add rejectExecution to the API client
summary: Add rejectExecution(token, id) to the admin API client, next to approveExecution and retryExecution.
description: Context: game/frontend/src/api/client.ts exports approveExecution and retryExecution, which POST to /api/v1/admin/executions/{id}/approve and /retry through adminRequest. There is no rejectExecution. Desired behavior: add rejectExecution(token, id), which POSTs to /api/v1/admin/executions/{id}/reject with the Bearer token. Expected result: later UI work can call it. Why: SG-6.4 needs a Reject action in AdminApp.
acceptance_criteria: Given a token and an execution id, when rejectExecution is called, then fetch is sent POST to /api/v1/admin/executions/{id}/reject with an Authorization Bearer header.
Given the server answers 401, when rejectExecution is called, then the promise rejects with an ApiError whose status is 401.
technical_constraints: Use adminRequest like approveExecution and retryExecution do.
definition_of_done: rejectExecution is exported from client.ts and the frontend type-checks.
